audience.description: Identifies the intended recipients of the token. This must include the application id assigned to our app by OP.

authorizedParty.description:
Identifies the authorized party (azp) to which the ID token was issued. This is the application id assigned to our
app by OP.

issuer.description: Identifies the idp (uri) that constructs and returns the token.

issuedAt.description: Identifies when the authentication for this token occurred.

identityProvider.description: Identifies IDP (uri) that authenticated the subject of the token.

notBefore.description: The nbf (not before) claim identifies the time before which JWT must not be accepted

expirationTime.description: The exp (expiry) claim identifies the expiration time of token in seconds since epoch.

codeHash.description: Identifies the code hash (c_hash), included only when the ID token is issued with OAuth 2.0 authorization code.

accessTokenHash.description:
Identifies the access token hash (at_hash), included only when the ID token is issued from /authorize end point
with OAuth2.0
access token.

preferredUsername.description:
Identifies the primary username (preferred_username) that represents the user. It could be an email address,
phone number or generic
username without a specified format.

name.description:
The name claim provides a human-readable value identifies the subject of the token via full name. Possibly includes
titles and suffixes.

givenName.description: The given name of the user, aka first name

familyName.description: The family name of the user, aka last name

nonce.description:
The nonce matches the parameter included in the original request to IDP. if does not match, application should
reject the token.

objectId.description: Immutable identifier (oid) for a user to track across all applications.

roles.description: The set of roles that were assigned to the user.

groups.description: The set of groups that were assigned to the user.

principal.description: Identifies the user (sub) unique to a particular application.

tenantId.description: A GUID that represents the tenant (tid) that the user is from. Identifies the organization that the user belongs

uniqueName.description: Provides a human readable value that identifies the subject (unique_name) of the token.

versionIdentifier.description: Indicates the version (ver) of the id_token

hasGroups.description: if true, this claim indicates that the user is at least belong to one group.

title: This type represents IdToken which is returned OIDC provider
name: OidcIdToken
